architecture.title: CI and test runners
architecture.stack: Azure Pipelines · JUnit / REST Assured · Playwright

artifacts.name: Accepted payment rule
artifacts.content:
Requirement: retry an accepted payment after a timeout.
Key: same request key + same amount → same transfer ID.
Expected: one journal; payer 90000, recipient 10000 minor units.
Open question: key-retention period requires product agreement.
artifacts.check: Expected financial behavior is agreed independently of the generated test. Open questions remain visible.
artifacts.handoff: Approved rule-r3 → domain QA; unresolved rules return to the product owner.

artifacts.name: Scenario matrix
artifacts.content:
C1  Timeout → same-key retry    → one transfer
C2  Concurrent same-key calls   → one transfer
C3  Same key, different amount  → reject conflict
C4  Repeated provider callback → one posting
artifacts.check: The matrix includes independent outcomes, concurrency and changed-payload behavior.
artifacts.handoff: Reviewed scenarios-r2 → automation and fixture owners.

artifacts.name: Synthetic fixture
artifacts.content:
run_id: sample-142
currency: CAD
payer_start: 100000 minor units
recipient_start: 0 minor units
amount: 10000 minor units
reset: isolated accounts recreated per run
artifacts.check: Balances and account relationships are valid; separate runs do not share mutable fixtures.
artifacts.handoff: fixtures-r4 + account IDs → the environment preflight.

artifacts.name: Run preflight
artifacts.content:
app_build: payment-example-a1
fixture_rev: fixtures-r4
provider_model: accepted-then-timeout-r2
readiness: app + database health checks required
retention: evidence stored outside disposable resources
cleanup_owner: platform on-call
artifacts.check: The provider substitute reproduces the intended failure. The real provider and settlement still need separate checks.
artifacts.handoff: Pinned manifest + usable environment → CI runner.

artifacts.name: Reviewed test change
artifacts.content:
AI candidate r1: assert response.status == 200
Reviewer: insufficient; this can miss a duplicate posting.
Revision r2: assert same transfer ID on retry
             assert journal count == 1
             assert balances == 90000 / 10000
Challenge: deliberate duplicate-posting variant MUST FAIL
artifacts.check: A candidate cannot weaken required assertions or skip the deliberate-defect check. This is sample pseudocode.
artifacts.handoff: Reviewed commit → CI; rejected candidates return to the author.

artifacts.name: Original run receipt
artifacts.content:
Candidate: review-r2
Correct behavior fixture: required assertions PASS
Deliberate duplicate variant: journal count 2 → FAIL (expected)
Candidate disposition: challenge detects the known defect
Required suite: other cases must still complete
Evidence: manifest + assertions + logs
artifacts.check: These are illustrative receipts, not executed results. Detecting the injected defect does not establish complete coverage.
artifacts.handoff: Original receipt + artifact links → QA triage and reviewer.

artifacts.name: Evidence-linked disposition
artifacts.content:
AI draft: duplicate journal observed after retry.
Evidence: sample-run-142 / assertion journal_count=2
Uncertainty: root cause not established by this assertion.
Human disposition: developer investigates transaction handling.
Retest: new build + fresh run; old failure stays retained.
artifacts.check: The diagnosis is traceable and uncertainty is preserved. A suggested fix does not close the defect.
artifacts.handoff: Named developer + reproducible failure → fix, fresh retest and domain review.

artifacts.name: Release evidence receipt
artifacts.content:
Requirement: rule-r3
Scenarios: scenarios-r2 / all required cases accounted for
Test + fixture + build: linked in run manifest
Defects: dispositions + fresh retest links required
Provider / settlement: separate evidence required
Decision: HOLD while required evidence is missing
artifacts.check: The release owner resolves required checks and exceptions. An AI summary cannot override a missing result.
artifacts.handoff: Reviewed evidence + explicit decision → accountable release owner.

lifecycle.title: Create and check
lifecycle.detail: Pin the build, tests and configuration. Provision supported resources and wait for health checks.

lifecycle.title: Seed and configure
lifecycle.detail: Create isolated synthetic accounts. Load the owned, versioned virtual-provider behavior.

lifecycle.title: Execute and challenge
lifecycle.detail: Run required tests. The deliberate duplicate-posting variant must fail its independent assertion.

lifecycle.title: Retain and review
lifecycle.detail: Keep original assertions, setup diagnostics and run IDs outside disposable resources. Review omissions.

lifecycle.title: Clean up on every path
lifecycle.detail: Attempt teardown after success or failure. Escalate failed cleanup to the named platform owner.

lifecycle.title: Reconcile integration
lifecycle.detail: Check the real provider and settlement separately. Contract drift triggers model review and rerun.
